spindle.observe.Binding.title: Binding
spindle.observe.Binding.description: One binding of the system. A periodic binding fires a command of `to` on a schedule and has no `from` and no `event`; an event binding carries `event` from `from` to a command of `to`. The schedule is ESS's, not Spindle's. Seven keys of the binding's `when.periodic` cause are published, each answered with the word the specification declares, as ESS defines it (ESS guide "Declare a periodic host cause", `ess_domain::binding::periodic`): `every`, `anchor`, `first`, `cadence`, `overlap`, `missed` and `lifetime`, which together say when a tick is due and which ticks are dropped. They are present for a periodic binding and absent for an event binding. The cause's two other keys, `cancellation` and `host`, are not published; `crates/spindle-timer/src/lib.rs` honours `cancellation` and `host.eligibility` too.

from.description: The component that publishes the event; absent for a periodic binding.

to.description: The component that accepts the command.

event.description: The qualified name of the event carried; absent for a periodic binding.

command.description: The qualified name of the command the binding issues.

every.description: ESS's `when.periodic.every`, the period as `PT<seconds>S`, such as `PT1S`; tick n is due one period after tick n-1 on the binding's grid. Absent for an event binding.

anchor.description: ESS's `when.periodic.anchor`, such as `host_activation`: the grid starts at the instant the binding's lifetime is activated. Absent for an event binding.

first.description: ESS's `when.periodic.first`, such as `after_period`: nothing is due at activation, and the first tick is one period later. Absent for an event binding.

cadence.description: ESS's `when.periodic.cadence`, such as `fixed_rate`: tick n is due at activation plus n periods, and completing a tick does not move the grid. Absent for an event binding.

overlap.description: ESS's `when.periodic.overlap`, such as `serial_per_instance`: no second tick is issued while one is still open. Absent for an event binding.

missed.description: ESS's `when.periodic.missed`, such as `one_pending_drop_excess`: deadlines that pass while a tick is open or unobserved keep one pending tick, the earliest, and the rest are dropped and counted. Absent for an event binding.

lifetime.description: ESS's `when.periodic.lifetime`, such as `host_instance`: a lifetime runs from activation to acknowledged stop and holds no durable state, so a new host instance starts a new grid. Absent for an event binding.
